tail.pathInvalid: Enter an absolute path on the machine, without control characters.
tail.pausedNotice: Paused. What is written to the file while paused is missed; following again reads the file's own tail from the top.

hint.syslog: Following the system log? Use /var/log/syslog — the file is written the moment anything happens, and the window keeps up.
hint.nginx: Watching what reaches a web service? Use /var/log/nginx/access.log — every request arrives here as it is served.
hint.missed: A pause stops the stream where it stands: lines written while paused are missed until you follow again.

forwards.empty: Nothing is being forwarded right now.
forwards.stopMessage: The forward on {bind} stops listening. Connections already carried are not broken, but nothing new gets through.
forwards.notHosted: Forwards ride a session with a connection — SSH, or the desktop session. This window cannot be hosted here.
forwards.openAskMessage: The policy matrix asks about this one: a remote forward listens on the server, and whoever reaches the server reaches the service behind it. Confirming carries your answer to the gate.

hint.local: A local forward maps a service inside the machine onto a port here: listen on 127.0.0.1, destination 127.0.0.1:25433, and that port here is the machine's database.
hint.dynamic: A dynamic forward turns the machine into a SOCKS5 door: listen on 127.0.0.1, choose port 1080, and anything pointed at it goes out from the machine.
hint.remote: A remote forward turns it around: the port opens on the server, answered by this machine. Whoever can reach the server reaches that service, which is why opening one always passes the policy gate first — the window asks, and the answer rides the open; a matrix set to deny still refuses, and loosening it is the only way past a denial.
